messages.name: Buy N Large admin
messages.body: Since 8am our bank sync gets 503 with IP-5030 on almost every call.

messages.name: Leo (Support)
messages.body: IP-5030 means a bank feed provider is unavailable. It is retryable with backoff. We had a provider incident this morning; see status.invoicepilot.example. Your requests should succeed once it recovers.
